method: WebFetch of each course's own imperial.ac.uk course page ('Fees and funding' section, 2027 entry), fetched with cache-busting query strings (2 or more fetches per course where readable), plus imperial.ac.uk/study/fees-and-funding/undergraduate/tuition-fees/. Direct curl is blocked. Bare /2027/ course URLs return 'too many redirects', so those were read with a query string. Some bare (unbusted) URLs returned an older copy saying 'Fees to be confirmed' / 'Not set' - see per-course notes. Overseas 2026-27 'as a guide' figures were deliberately not recorded anywhere.

universityWideStatements.quote: 2027–28 academic year: Maximum fee for standard full-time courses will increase to £10,050 per year.
universityWideStatements.title: Tuition fees | Study | Imperial College London
universityWideStatements.appliesTo: Statement of the UK maximum (fee cap) for standard full-time courses in 2027-28. It does not explicitly state Imperial's own Home fee for every course, and says nothing about Overseas fees (page says Overseas fees are set by Imperial and given on course pages), so it is NOT used as a university-wide course fee.

fees.sourceTitle: Physics BSc | Study | Imperial College London
fees.note: Course page shows Home fee for 2027 entry with no caveat. Unqualified-URL fetches (no query string) returned an older-looking copy of the page saying Home "£10,050* per year / Fees to be confirmed" and Overseas "Not set"; repeated cache-busted fetches (?v=2,5,6,7,8,9 and ?utm=x) all showed the figures recorded here. The figures supersede 'not set/TBC' wording, so the former is treated as a stale cached copy. Re-check live page before relying on it.
